fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShip.*Run' shows the ship record naming the run after ship.open-pr, ship.check and ship.rebase run under one RHIZA_RUN, and naming a second run after that run's ship.check on the same change set
fields.statement: Each ship step that opens, checks or pushes a change set's PR (ship.open-pr, ship.check, ship.land, ship.rebase, and the watchdog's merge of main on behalf of a run) records in the change set's ship record the run it ran for (RHIZA_RUN, or the run the watchdog acted for), so the record names the run that opened or last pushed the PR

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdog(GreenUnmerged|ReadPR|CIRerun|PRNoCI)', with a fake gh, shows: a succeeded plan run of a change set whose ship record names a later ship-change run gets no inbox item, no resume and no merge (the inbox item 0568a71 case); the same with the ship-change run live or its continue queued; a ship record naming no run gives every run no PR; and the owning run still gets its hold or resume as before
fields.statement: The watchdog's shared PR read gives a run its change set's PR only when the ship record names that run, and no PR when it names another run or none, so the green-unmerged, CI-rerun and no-CI passes never act on or raise an inbox item about a PR another run owns; the green-unmerged pass also skips a change set any of whose runs is live or has a continue queued
